title: Threatens to leak a video or photos
why: This is blackmail. Paying never stops it, because the person asks again. They often have nothing at all and are bluffing.
examples: I have recorded your video call. Pay Rs 20,000 or I will send it to your family and friends.
Your private video will go viral and be shared with your contacts unless you pay.
safe: Your video has been uploaded to YouTube successfully.
I recorded the lecture for you. Sharing it with the class group.
